thread:
sofia: FYI customer ACME (ticket INC-4021) reporting ~8% of requests show no spans/links in Trace Panel after today's deploy. Logs have request IDs but Trace Panel returns "not found". sample req id: req-8f3a2c. Screenshot attached to ticket.
support-bot: Escalation created INC-4021 and assigned to support. ETA 2h.
leo: Can you paste minimal repro and a sample span payload? Which env/region (prod-us-east)?
sofia: Repro steps:
1) Send request with X-Request-ID header.
2) Call /v1/generate twice.
3) Wait ~30s and check console traces by request_id.
Curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req-8f3a2c" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Sanitized sample span payload from customer:
```
{"trace_id":"t-111aaa","span_id":"s-222bbb","parent_id":null,"request_id":"req-8f3a2c","service":"frontend","timestamp":1681234567890}
```
maria: Heads-up — we rolled span-canonicalization v2 at 08:14 UTC, it changed trace_id hashing and tag normalization. Could be a migration edge-case. :eyes: 
tim: Infra noticed a kafka consumer lag spike ~08:20 UTC, backlog ~2k msgs on span-ingest. If processing reorders, request_id upserts might be lost.
ingest-team: Pulling logs for req-8f3a2c now. Do you have a raw envelope_id or any parent spans? Need the raw payload to find the write path.
sofia: Here's an additional payload from our logs (sanitized):
```
{"envelope_id":"env-987","trace_id":"t-111aaa","span_id":"s-333ccc","parent_id":"s-222bbb","request_id":"req-8f3a2c","operation":"http.request","duration_ms":12}
```
ingest-team: Quick initial check: we see two spans for trace t-111aaa but span_index table lacks the request_id tag for that trace. Looks like the indexer upsert for request_id didn't persist. Kicking a reindex for that trace now.
leo: Sounds like a race between canonicalizer and indexer upsert. @ingest-team add debug around upsert(path) and include envelope_id env-987. Also capture consumer offsets 08:10-08:30.
ingest-team: Acknowledged. Reindex + debug logs running, will report in ~30m. :thumbsup: 
sofia: I've told the customer we're investigating and asked for more examples. Escalating to account manager if SLA impact visible.
maria: If reindex doesn't restore links we should hotfix: ensure request_id is attached to the span document before index commit (atomic write). Preparing a patch branch now. :thinking: 
tim: If this is indexer race we'll prioritize a hotfix. Let us know if reindex fixes the panel.
ingest-team: Reindex finished for t-111aaa — request_id upserted, Trace Panel now links and shows both spans. Reindexed ~420 traces from the affected window. Observability shows missing-request-links dropping. :tada: 
sofia: Great, pinging customer with update and asking for confirmation. Closing interim alert for ACME.
maria: Follow-up: adding an integration test for canonicalizer -> indexer to catch this.
leo: Thanks team. Action items: (1) ingest-team keep debug logs for 48h for that window, (2) maria open patch PR if reindexing surfaces other failures, (3) sofia collect any other customer examples.
ingest-team: Will keep logs and have a runbook entry for reindexing affected traces.
sofia: Filed follow-up ticket SR-1256 to track test + hotfix. Thanks all.
